about: Release / announcement calendar for the event rule: within window_days before a major event (on the day itself too), a Buy-zone price shows as Watch on the site and the evaluation skill won't call Buy, unless the price is at Definitely-buy. scope "all" = every card; a list of set codes (e.g. ["M6a"]) = only cards from those sets. Events with d = null are rumoured/undated: listed, never applied. Edit with scripts/events.py. The rule rests on one release (9/15–16: two Buy calls beaten by 5–12% dips); scripts/event_study.py measures every release from our own checks (FULL-CHECK step 8e). Historical test 2026-10-02 (SNKRDUNK daily PSA10 1枚 sale prices, 12 tracked cards, 23 releases Sep 2023–Sep 2026, 126 card-release windows): the average price over the 4 days after a release was 2.0% lower than over the 4 days before it, compared with each card's normal 4-day change (95% CI −2.8% to −1.2%); 18 of 23 releases were below normal; a 5%+ dip within 4 days happened from 22% of rule-window days vs 14% of other days. Real but small: the rule mostly saves about 2%; big dips like 9/16 (−5 to −12%) are the exception.
